sentences.en: In Japan beef has a high degree of marbled fat.
sentences.zh: 在日本，牛肉含有较高的大理石纹脂肪。

sentences.en: This statue was carved from a single block of marble.
sentences.zh: 这座雕像是一整块大理石雕刻而成的。

sentences.en: The statue was hewn out of the purest white marble.
sentences.zh: 这座雕像是由最纯净的白色大理石雕琢出来的。
